items.title: Gerald "Tadpole" Joseph Interview, 1969-06-10
items.q: I played, uh, somewhat of a rally for Mr. Hale Boggs at the Seafarers Hotel... I met the guys, uh, shook their hand and talked to them for a while.

ctx.x: So when I got about the age of, uh, 15, 16 years old, uh, I switched over to the slide trombone, and I still was taking music lessons. Every Saturday for now, uh, Crescent City Music Hall, uh, went down and a half a lesson. And, uh, uh, started taking music lessons in school, playing, uh, in a school band. Uh, I remember I played my first solo when I was at, uh, attending McDonald's number 41. Uh, band director, Mr. Dennis, uh, he gave me an acting role I liked to play a solo, and I did that, uh, school exercise.…
That's fair. What about when you got started, if we can back up, on the valve trombone? Did anybody help you? Did you just pick it up on your own or what?
